component.name: TotK Recomp Setup
component.summary: Build Tears of the Kingdom for this PC from your own game files

description.p: TotK Recomp is a static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (Nintendo Switch) into a native PC application. This is its setup program: it reads your own dump of the game, translates and compiles it for this machine, and prepares the shader cache so the first launch does not stutter.
This is an unofficial Flatpak wrapper around the official upstream Linux AppImage release. It packages the installer as-is.

IMPORTANT: This package contains no game files, keys, firmware or dumping tools. You must supply your own legally obtained copy of the game (base game and update, as XCI, NSP or NSZ) and your own prod.keys, dumped from your own console. The setup then recompiles the game locally with the bundled toolchain; the result is a normal executable in the folder you choose, which you run as-is from outside the sandbox.
Requirements: an x86-64 CPU with AVX2 for the default build (an SSE4.2-only CPU gets a slower build), a GPU with a Vulkan 1.3 driver, 16 GB of RAM and about 40 GB of free disk space for the build.

developer.name: Flatpak packaging: jcleng; upstream: valentderah and the TotK Recomp contributors

description.p: Packages the upstream TotK Recomp 0.3.13 Linux setup AppImage release.
